findings.claim: frank-demo is a static Vercel-targeted SPA with dynamic page modules for home/features/swarm/gallery/lab/logs/proposals/mail and presentation assets. Its central home path explicitly labels itself demo mode and generates fake mood, fake history and static activity messages rather than reading authoritative FRANK runtime state.
findings.implication: Archive ingestion must source-label demo/synthetic presentation state and prevent it from being reconciled as current architecture/runtime evidence or unlabelled training truth.

findings.claim: The demo is a complete static HTML/CSS/ES-module website with a local single-layer perceptron/bag-of-words intent responder and multiple functional presentation pages. It can become a non-FRANK static-website conformance fixture for the ClayCode general-purpose compiler/runtime, but only after an actual compile/serve receipt.
findings.implication: Keep as candidate HTTP/static-web application fixture; do not credit historical hours until current ClayCode compiles/serves it or an equivalent fixture.

progress_accounting.reason: Source is fully identity-enumerated and usefully classified, but contains presentation/demo material rather than a unique reusable research mechanism.
